I replied to Dana in her DM to confirm I have the note: she now uses Dock 15 for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups, and it stays private.

I checked GBrain first. It had nothing on her dock, only a North team cheat sheet with a general Tamsin Cold Chain support note. I took no other action.

I did not save the dock note to GBrain on purpose. GBrain is shared, so storing it there could let other people see something she asked me to keep between us. The DM itself is the record. If you'd rather have it in GBrain, it would need a private setting there, and I didn't confirm whether one exists.
